name: Villar de Peralonso (Spain)
description: Seven vertical stripes of green, yellow, blue, white, blue, yellow and green with a broad white central stripe charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villar de Peralonso (a cross and a plough on green).
history: The municipal flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, tierced vertically with a double-width white centre bearing the municipal arms, and at the hoist green, yellow and blue, the green stripe double the others.

features.role: Villar de Peralonso arms — cross and plough on green
